command: gh (feature detection, every command that lists or views): Issue
gh (feature detection): Repository, Mutation and an input type, in one document
query: query Detect { Repository: __type(name: "Repository") { fields { name } } Mutation: __type(name: "Mutation") { fields { name args { name type { name kind ofType { name kind } } } } } Input: __type(name: "CreatePullRequestInput") { inputFields { name } } Statuses: __type(name: "StatusState") { enumValues { name } } }

command: gh api graphql -f query='{ __schema { queryType { name } types { name kind } } }'
query: { __schema { queryType { name } mutationType { name } types { name kind } } }

query PullRequestStatus($owner: String!, $repo: String!, $headRefName: String!, $viewerQuery: String!, $reviewerQuery: String!, $per_page: Int = 10) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $repo) { defaultBranchRef { name } pullRequests(headRefName: $headRefName, first: $per_page, orderBy: {field: CREATED_AT, direction: DESC}) { totalCount edges { node { number title url state isDraft headRefName reviewDecision mergeStateStatus commits(last: 1) { nodes { commit { statusCheckRollup { state } } } } } } } } viewerCreated: search(query: $viewerQuery, type: ISSUE, first: $per_page) { totalCount: issueCount edges { node { ...on PullRequest { number title url state isDraft headRefName reviewDecision } } } } reviewRequested: search(query: $reviewerQuery, type: ISSUE, first: $per_page) { totalCount: issueCount edges { node { ...on PullRequest { number title url } } } } }

query PullRequestSearch($q: String!, $limit: Int!, $endCursor: String) { search(query: $q, type: ISSUE, first: $limit, after: $endCursor) { issueCount nodes { ...on PullRequest { number title state url headRefName isDraft createdAt labels(first: 100) { nodes { name } totalCount } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

command: gh pr create -R github.localhost/acme/app (an open pull request for the branch, and the template)
query: query PullRequestForBranch($owner: String!, $repo: String!, $headRefName: String!) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $repo) { pullRequests(headRefName: $headRefName, states: [OPEN], first: 30, orderBy: {field: CREATED_AT, direction: DESC}) { nodes { id number title state url headRefName baseRefName headRepositoryOwner { login } isCrossRepository isDraft maintainerCanModify } } pullRequestTemplates { body filename } } }

command: gh pr create -R github.localhost/acme/app (the pull request)
query: mutation PullRequestCreate($input: CreatePullRequestInput!) { createPullRequest(input: $input) { pullRequest { id number url } } }

command: gh issue create -R github.localhost/acme/app (templates, then the issue)
query: query IssueTemplates($owner: String!, $name: String!) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) { id hasIssuesEnabled isBlankIssuesEnabled issueTemplates { name title body about filename } contactLinks { name url about } labels(first: 100) { nodes { id name } } milestones(first: 100, states: OPEN) { nodes { id number title } } assignableUsers(first: 100) { nodes { id login name } } } }
mutation IssueCreate($input: CreateIssueInput!) { createIssue(input: $input) { issue { id url number } } }

query RepositoryInfo($owner: String!, $name: String!) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) { assignableUsers(first: 100) { nodes { login } totalCount } codeOfConduct { name key url } contactLinks { name url about } fundingLinks { platform url } issueTemplates { name filename } pullRequestTemplates { filename } mentionableUsers(first: 100) { totalCount } } }
